context.reviewSummary: WS1 meets all acceptance criteria. HeroSection.tsx renders the 9 real Firewatch photographic PNG layers (parallax0 sky/back .. parallax8 trees/front) as elements (not SVG), z-stacked 0..8 in correct depth order. The rAF engine exclusively owns each layer's inline transform (wrappers oversize via -inset-[5%], no transform utility classes), honoring the guardrail. Mouse + scroll parallax wired via single rAF reading native scrollY (capped) + pointermove; no Lenis, no GSAP pin. Reduced-motion returns early. PRADIPTA JANA overlays at z-20, legible with drop-shadow. Role-cycler span has no React children (no textContent crash). tsc --noEmit exits 0.
